    (Ico 1 (k + 1)) = (Ico 1 (max_j + 1)).biUnion I_j := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, Finset.mem_biUnion, I_j]
    constructor
    · intro h_in
      rcases h_in with ⟨hi, hk⟩
      have h_ge : 1 ≤ i := hi
      have h_lt : i < k + 1 := hk
      -- Find j such that j^2 ≤ i < (j+1)^2
      have h_sqrt_le : Nat.sqrt i * Nat.sqrt i ≤ i := Nat.sqrt_le i
      have h_exists_j : ∃ j, j * j ≤ i ∧ i < (j + 1) * (j + 1) := by
        use Nat.sqrt i
        constructor
        · exact Nat.sqrt_le i
        · have h := Nat.lt_succ_sqrt i
          omega
      rcases h_exists_j with ⟨j, hj1, hj2⟩
      
      -- Check j is in range [1, max_j]
      have h_j_ge : 1 ≤ j := by
        by_contra h
        have h_j_zero : j = 0 := by omega
        rw [h_j_zero] at hj2
        have h_i_lt_1 : i < 1 := by simp [h_j_zero] at hj2; omega
        omega
      
      have h_j_le : j ≤ max_j := by
        have h_j_sq : j * j ≤ i := hj1
        have h_i_lt_k : i < k + 1 := hk
        have h_j_le_sqrt_k : j ≤ Nat.sqrt k := Nat.le_sqrt.mpr h_j_sq
        rw [h_max_j_def]
        exact h_j_le_sqrt_k
      
      refine' ⟨j, _, _⟩
      constructor
      · simp [h_j_ge, h_j_le]
      · constructor
        · simp [hj1]
        · simp [hj2]
        · simp [h_i_lt_k]
        
    · intro h_in
      rcases h_in with ⟨j, hj_range, hj_in⟩
      rcases hj_range with ⟨hj1, hj2⟩
      rcases hj_in with ⟨hj_low, hj_high⟩
      constructor
      · have h_j_ge : j ≥ 1 := hj1
        have h_i_ge : i ≥ j * j := hj_low
        have h_j_sq_ge : j * j ≥ 1 := by nlinarith
        omega
      · have h_i_lt : i < min ((j + 1) * (j + 1)) (k + 1) := hj_high
        have h_min_le : min ((j + 1) * (j + 1)) (k + 1) ≤ k + 1 := by
          apply min_le_right
        omega
  
  -- Disjointness
  have h_disjoint : PairwiseDisjoint (Ico 1 (max_j + 1)) I_j := by
    intro j1 hj1 j2 hj2 h_inter
    rcases hj1 with ⟨hj1_low, hj1_high⟩
    rcases hj2 with ⟨hj2_low, hj2_high⟩
    rcases h_inter with ⟨i, hi1, hi2⟩
    simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, I_j] at hi1 hi2
    have h_i_ge_j1sq : i ≥ j1 * j1 := hi1.1
    have h_i_lt_j1sq : i < min ((j1 + 1) * (j1 + 1)) (k + 1) := hi1.2
    have h_i_ge_j2sq : i ≥ j2 * j2 := hi2.1
    have h_i_lt_j2sq : i < min ((j2 + 1) * (j2 + 1)) (k + 1) := hi2.2
    
    cases' lt_or_eq_of_le (by omega : j1 ≤ j2 ∨ j2 ≤ j1) with h_le_j h_le_j
    · -- j1 ≤ j2
      by_cases h_eq : j1 = j2
      · subst h_eq
        exact Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem fun _ _ => False.elim (by contradiction)
      · have h_lt : j1 < j2 := lt_of_le_of_ne h_le_j h_eq
        have h_j2_ge_j1_plus_1 : j2 ≥ j1 + 1 := by omega
        have h_j2_sq_ge_j1_plus_1_sq : j2 * j2 ≥ (j1 + 1) * (j1 + 1) := by
          nlinarith
        have h_i_ge_j2_sq : i ≥ j2 * j2 := h_i_ge_j2sq
        have h_i_lt_j1_sq : i < (j1 + 1) * (j1 + 1) := by
          have h_min_le : min ((j1 + 1) * (j1 + 1)) (k + 1) ≤ (j1 + 1) * (j1 + 1) := by apply min_le_left
          linarith
        omega
    · -- j2 ≤ j1
      by_cases h_eq : j1 = j2
      · subst h_eq
        exact Set.eq_empty_of_forall_not_mem fun _ _ => False.elim (by contradiction)
      · have h_lt : j2 < j1 := lt_of_le_of_ne h_le_j h_eq
        have h_j1_ge_j2_plus_1 : j1 ≥ j2 + 1 := by omega
        have h_j1_sq_ge_j2_plus_1_sq : j1 * j1 ≥ (j2 + 1) * (j2 + 1) := by
          nlinarith
        have h_i_ge_j1_sq : i ≥ j1 * j1 := h_i_ge_j1sq
        have h_i_lt_j2_sq : i < (j2 + 1) * (j2 + 1) := by
          have h_min_le : min ((j2 + 1) * (j2 + 1)) (k + 1) ≤ (j2 + 1) * (j2 + 1) := by apply min_le_left
          linarith
        omega
  
  -- Sum decomposition
  have h_sum_decomp : 
    (Ico 1 (k + 1)).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) = 
    (Ico 1 (max_j + 1)).sum (fun j => 
      (I_j j).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ))) := by
    rw [h_partition_cover]
    rw [Finset.sum_biUnion h_disjoint]
    · simp_all
    · exact h_disjoint
  
  -- Term bound
  have h_term_bound : ∀ j ∈ Ico 1 (max_j + 1), 
    (I_j j).sum (fun i => x i / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 
    x (j * j) / (j : ℝ) * 3 := by
    intro j hj
    rcases hj with ⟨hj1, hj2⟩
    have h_j_ge : j ≥ 1 := hj1
    have h_j_le : j ≤ max_j := hj2
    
    have h_le : ∀ i ∈ I_j j, x i ≤ x (j * j) := by
      intro i hi
      have h_ge : j * j ≤ i := by
        simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, I_j] at hi
        exact hi.1
      have h_mono : x i ≤ x (j * j) := by
        have h_dec : ∀ m n, m ≤ n → x m ≥ x n := by
          intro m n hm
          induction' hm with n hn IH
          · simp
          · apply hmono
        exact h_dec (j * j) i h_ge
      exact h_mono
    
    have h_sum_inv : (I_j j).sum (fun i => 1 / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 
      ((I_j j).card : ℝ) / (j * j : ℝ) := by
      have h_lower : ∀ i ∈ I_j j, (i : ℝ) ≥ j * j := by
        intro i hi
        simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, I_j] at hi
        norm_cast
        linarith
      
      calc
        (I_j j).sum (fun i => 1 / (i : ℝ)) ≤ 
          (I_j j).sum (fun i => 1 / (j * j : ℝ)) := by
          apply Finset.sum_le_sum
          intro i hi
          have h_i_ge : (i : ℝ) ≥ j * j := h_lower i hi
          have h_pos : 0 < (i : ℝ) := by
            simp only [Finset.mem_Ico, I_j] at hi
            norm_cast
            linarith
          have h_jj_pos : 0 < (j * j : ℝ) := by positivity
          rw [div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]
          nlin
